q: How is this different from asking ChatGPT about my brand myself?
a_html: One answer is one draw from a varying process. The audit asks each question in several wordings, many times, and reports a mention rate with a 95% confidence interval. See why one screenshot proves nothing.

q: Is this the same as what customers see in the ChatGPT app?
a_html: No. Answers come from the ChatGPT API with web search and, for the Full audit, from Claude through Claude Code's web search. They are not taken from the consumer ChatGPT app or claude.ai and may differ from what an individual user sees.

q: Do you guarantee rankings or more mentions?
a_html: No. The audit measures where you stand and what the assistants cite. It does not change what they say, and nothing on this site promises a ranking or traffic.

q: How do you decide whether my brand was mentioned?
a_html: Deterministic matching of the brand name, agreed aliases and domains in the answer text. No model judges the answers. See the method.

It varies by theme. Sampling continues until each theme's mention rate is within about ±10 percentage points, so stable themes need fewer answers than mixed ones. The Teamwork.com study used 280 answers across 6 themes.

q: What is the difference between Snapshot and Full?
a_html: Snapshot (£249) covers ChatGPT and 6 question themes, delivered in 5 working days. Full (£749) covers ChatGPT and Claude, 10 to 15 themes, with findings and recommended actions, delivered in 7 working days. See the offer.
An HTML report and a PDF, sent by email. There is no login or dashboard.
